name: WatchParty
description: Netflix-style cinema UI and synchronized Watch Party with voice chat for Jellyfin.
overview: Drop-in plugin providing an immersive Netflix-grade cinema frontend served directly at /tokoshan and real-time synchronized Watch Party with sub-100ms sync, live chat, floating reactions, and WebRTC voice chat.

versions.changelog: Initial release with Netflix UI, sub-100ms sync, live chat, floating reactions, and WebRTC voice chat.
